primary_endpoint: Rate of amino acid catabolism in the presence/absence of glucagon at 0, 120, and 240 minutes.
efficacy_outcome: Reported amino acid catabolism values were 17, 26, and 20 at one timepoint; 12, 19, and 22 at another; and 10, 16, and 14 at the third, across the listed participant groups. The source does not clearly map these values to timepoints or report a treatment comparison.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events or deaths were reported in the groups with participants; the two type 2 diabetes groups had 0 participants.
